Devon (Partner SE): New AWS Marketplace listing goes live next week — need to confirm partner support escalation path. Who owns the SEV channel + war-room setup? cc @Ash @María
Ash Patel: I can own initial triage for marketplace listings. We should add a shared channel with the partner and our oncall. What's the oncall channel for marketplace incidents? :thinking:
María Gómez: For high-sev we route through #incidents + PagerDuty. For partner-facing ops we usually spin up a private shared channel between the partner and our PartnerOps team. Recommend naming convention: `#partners/<partner>-<product>-ops`.
Ethan Li: Oncall here — PagerDuty escalation policy for marketplace SEVs is 15m -> 30m -> 60m. If the partner incident affects model serving (OOM, bad weights, corrupted artifact) page SRE immediately. We need a short runbook link in the channel.
Devon (Partner SE): Quick draft escalation matrix below — can we agree?
```
Escalation Level | Owner (initial)      | Escalate after
-----------------|----------------------|--------------
P0 / SEV-1       | SRE oncall + PartnerSE | 15 minutes -> page SRE lead
P1              | PartnerOps + Product  | 30 minutes -> rotate to Eng oncall
P2              | Support + PartnerSE   | 60 minutes -> review next steps
```
Ash Patel: That looks good. For marketplace listings specifically, we should also include a rollback play: unpublish listing or switch to fallback model variant. Add that to runbook. :thumbsup:
Samira Khan: I can create the shared channel and set permissions. Also propose a dedicated "war-room" rotation for partner incidents: PM, Partner SE, SRE oncall, Support TL. Can PartnerOps Bot auto-create the war-room from a template?
PartnerOps Bot: Created private shared channel `#partners/aws-marketplace-redwood` and sent invites to the listed partner contacts + @Ash, @Samira, @Ethan. War room template: https://runbook.internal/redwood/marketplace-warroom (accessible to invited members). :white_check_mark:
Ash Patel: Nice. For communications: use the shared channel for ops-level discussion, and always post a short incident summary to #incidents with the incident ID and link to the war-room.
María Gómez: Note on logs — partner must provide tenant logs or S3 read access for post-mortem. If they can't, SRE triage will be limited; escalate to Product and Legal if access can't be granted. Add to onboarding checklist.
Ethan Li: Let's schedule a fire-drill: test page and war-room creation next Tue 09:00 PST. I'll volunteer as first responder.
Devon (Partner SE): Perfect. Samira — can you confirm the invite list and escalation mapping by EOD tomorrow? :pray:
Samira Khan: Yes — will send calendar invite, PagerDuty rotation mapping, and attach a short runbook snippet in the new shared channel. I'll also add the onboarding checklist item for log access and the rollback steps.
Ash Patel: Thanks everyone. Once Samira confirms, I'll run a quick canary day with the partner to validate the flow. :eyes:
